decision: Normalize contentHtml at mapDetail time into static HTML safe for v-html. Do not compile Vue SFCs at runtime (runtime-only Vue build, bundle cost, XSS).
steps: If payload looks like a Vue SFC, unwrap innermost/outer <template> innerHTML
If script has codeSnippets template literals, replace {{ currentCodeSnippet }} pre/code with static stacked <pre><code> blocks
Strip remaining Vue directives (@, :, v-) and mustaches
